overview: This Senate resolution supports the goals of National Forensic Science Week, September 20 to 26, 2026. Forensic science is the use of scientific methods, such as DNA analysis and fingerprint matching, to investigate crimes. The resolution says forensic labs help identify the right perpetrators, clear people who are wrongly accused, and maintain federal crime databases. It encourages labs to host community events and tours, invites local officials, the public, the media and law enforcement to visit labs and learn about their needs, and suggests local leaders issue their own proclamations. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on September 30, 2026.
for: Supporters say forensic scientists do essential behind-the-scenes work for justice, and the week helps the public and policymakers understand what labs need to do it well.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic: it does not change any law or provide new funding for forensic laboratories.
